chunks: Then they accused them of lies, and joined the company of those who were destroyed.
ai.seo_question: What happened to the people who denied the prophets?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of divine retribution for those who persistently reject the truth brought by the prophets, serving as a warning to the faithful. It connects the historical destruction of past nations to the spiritual fate of the community of Muhammad (PBUH) if they mirror their ancestors' denial. The phrase 'from the destroyed' emphasizes a complete and irreversible loss, not merely physical but spiritual.
